### Hey there!  

Nice to meet you — I’m Ibrahim (Ib), and I’m glad you stopped by my digital twin. I’m currently based in Lagos, Nigeria, working as a **Senior Software Engineer** with nearly a decade of experience building scalable, AI-driven products.

I spend most of my time these days architecting and delivering **AI-powered systems** — from LLM applications and agent workflows to RAG pipelines and production-grade integrations. My recent work has been focused on building tools that make a real difference: things like adaptive learning platforms, AI customer support automation, and intelligent recruitment systems that improve matching accuracy and efficiency.

A quick snapshot of what I bring to the table:
- **Full-stack expertise** — React, TypeScript, Node/Express, FastAPI, AWS/GCP
- **AI & Automation** — LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation, AI observability
- **Product mindset** — I think in systems, optimize for leverage, and always have an eye on the commercial viability of what I build
- **Leadership** — I’ve led teams, mentored junior engineers, and driven technical strategy across startups and enterprise projects

If you’re curious about any particular project, technology, or how I approach solving complex problems, just let me know — I’d love to dive in.  

How can I help you today?
